title: [placeholder] Catch
prompt: blocks fall from the top and you move a basket to catch them
source:
# catch.8o - catch falling blocks in a basket and count the score.
# Mechanic: random spawns, falling objects, overlap test, score shown with the built-in hex font.
# Controls: key 4 (keyboard Q) = left, key 6 (keyboard E) = right.

:alias bx    v0   # basket x
:alias ix    v1   # falling item x
:alias iy    v2   # falling item y
:alias score v3
:alias t     v4   # scratch
:alias one   v5   # constant 1
:alias by    v6   # basket y (constant)
:alias sx    v7   # score x (constant)
:alias sy    v8   # score y (constant)

: basket
  0x81 0xFF
: item
  0x60 0xF0 0x60

# wait for 1 timer tick (60 per second)
: tick
  t := 1
  delay := t
  loop
    t := delay
    while t != 0
  again
  return

# the score is a single digit 0..9, drawn at the top right
: draw-score
  i := hex score
  sprite sx sy 5
  return

: draw-basket
  i := basket
  sprite bx by 2
  return

: draw-item
  i := item
  sprite ix iy 3
  return

# pick a new random column for the item and restart it at the top
: spawn
  ix := random 63
  if ix > 56 then ix := 56
  iy := 6
  return

: move-basket
  t := 4
  if t key begin
    if bx != 0 then bx -= one
    if bx != 0 then bx -= one
  end
  t := 6
  if t key begin
    if bx != 56 then bx += 1
    if bx != 56 then bx += 1
  end
  return

# called when the item reaches the basket row: did it land inside?
: check-catch
  # item is 4 wide (ix..ix+3), basket is 8 wide (bx..bx+7)
  t := ix
  t += 3
  t -= bx
  if vf == 1 begin
    t := bx
    t += 7
    t -= ix
    if vf == 1 begin
      draw-score
      score += 1
      if score == 10 then score := 0
      draw-score
    end
  end
  return

: main
  one := 1
  by := 29
  sx := 58
  sy := 0
  bx := 28
  score := 0
  draw-score
  spawn
  loop
    draw-item
    draw-basket
    move-basket
    iy += 1
    if iy == 26 begin
      check-catch
      spawn
    end
    draw-basket
    draw-item
    tick
  again
